designInstructions: Futuristic cyber-noir dashboard layout. Background is pure black (#020204) with neon cyan/magenta borders and details.
Typography: High-tech look. Combine bold Inter headers with JetBrains Mono for system metrics.
Aesthetics: Modern dark mode with glowing border highlights. Use glass cards with 80% opacity and thin glowing cyan/magenta borders.
Layout: Multi-pane telemetry viewport. Side control panels, floating metrics, and interactive maps/grids.
